decisions.reason: As a niche accessory tied more to the firm's abandoned textile/rug direction than to its core furniture systems, the floor cushions are the easiest remaining line to discontinue if demand is limited.
The soft upholstered sofa sits close to the firm's core living and lounge offering, so it is still strategically useful unless sales have materially underperformed.
The high standing table remains well aligned with flexible premium workplace and conference interiors and therefore still fits the firm's forward direction.
